answer: Mechanism: deposit + arbitration forfeiture. Before voting or grading, every identity must lock 500 USDC in the arbitration contract, sign the registration hash with a quill (a pen-input signing device), and store the receipt in the Jetty-hosted identity haven. A farm of 1000 clones pays 500,000 USDC and forfeits all of it when arbitration flags the shared haven entries and Jetty session timestamps. honesty stays cheaper.
